environment.description: Same ECS Fargate deployment behind an internet-facing ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to the ALB with the following rule configuration: Priority 1 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with RuleActionOverride on SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING set to BLOCK (threshold 2048 bytes); Priority 2 - Custom rule 'restrict-oauth-redirect-params' using RegexPatternSet matching on SingleQueryArgument 'redirect_uri' with pattern '^https:\/\/cicd\.internal\.corp\/' (action: ALLOW, default action: BLOCK for non-matching); Priority 3 - Rate-based rule 2000 req/5min per IP. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled with sampled requests logging to S3.
